fact: From 1 to 22 October 2024 two French military IT specialists helped the Gendarmerie nationale djiboutienne set up a secure 'IntraGend' network, which let the headquarters again exchange messages and share files with its distant brigades; the text names no system for recording complaints or cases (class: enabling).
title: FFDj - Partenariat informatique avec la Gendarmerie nationale djiboutienne
